scenarios.name: ooze-and-base-pt-apply-to-a-vehicle-crewed-after-it-entered
scenarios.why: March of the World Ooze entered before the Vehicle was crewed. The crew effect makes the Vehicle an artifact creature (layer 4), and March's layer-4 type addition and layer-7b base P/T depend on it: applying the crew effect changes which objects 'creatures you control' covers, so the crewed Vehicle is an Ooze in addition to its other types with base power and toughness 6/6 (CR 613.8a). Timestamp order would apply March first, before the Vehicle is a creature, and miss it.
